message.content: {"answer": "D", "option_text": "The chest X-ray demonstrates multiple extrapleural masses with involvement of the ribs and subpleural nodules, indicating intrathoracic recurrence.", "reason": "The provided images are CT scans (not chest X-rays), but they clearly demonstrate the findings described in option D: Figure 3 shows a large right-sided mass with rib destruction/extrapleural origin; Figure 4 shows a left epidiaphragmatic mass; and Figure 5 reveals multiple subpleural nodules.
